implementation.instructions: Resolve own Skill directory from advertised host configuration and pass its exact path using --target-directory. Preserve existing files and use package-managed source/status/install/update commands.
Use the host advertised local image viewing capability. Inspect every image and crop at full detail when needed. Missing visual inspection is a reported gap.

Use nano-product-replacement doctor, capabilities, inspect, blackout and collect. Resolve the installed CLI and verify required features. Use inspect coordinate/overlay/crop artifacts and shared polygon validation; ordinary runs do not import package dependencies or write image algorithms.

Follow the explicit human model/provider selection and advertised host media capability. When SealSeek is explicitly selected, resolve and fully read sealseek-media through its skill source contract. Return FEATURE_UNSUPPORTED for missing required features.

os_evidence: Portable CLI contract only; resolve host image inspection and generation capabilities before use. No named host/OS runtime evidence.
